consumer: The PICKUP selector's input loop in pick_up_from_items (pickup.cpp), which asks 'which ground items did the player navigate to and CONFIRM for pickup?' by consuming UP/DOWN/RIGHT/CONFIRM/QUIT actions via ctxt.handle_input().
scope: the ground-item stack reachable for pickup at the nearby tile(s) — the pile on the ground (map::i_at), not the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/pickup.cpp::pick_up_from_items — registers navigation/select actions on an input_context("PICKUP") and runs handle_input() to mark selections and finalize on CONFIRM; the chosen set is produced by this interactive loop, not by reading the export JSON.
divergence: A pile where one stack is selectable and another is excluded by an engine rule (e.g. an item too heavy/over volume, or a liquid needing a container): driving the real menu refuses or gates that entry, but synthesizing the choice from entities.items[] (Excerpt 1) would 'pick' it anyway — exposing the wrong authority.
